scientific_integrity: The result is a self-contained exact theorem for the unitary divisor sum and Euler totient. Public comparison literature distinguishes ordinary and unitary divisor sums. Finite verification does not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only support size at most two, plus global parity obstruction. Cases of odd support at least three remain open in this analysis; no independent audit performed.
title: The two-prime-support fiber of the unitary divisor sum–totient ratio
